body: Drake gave away a total of $500,000 to 10 lucky fans on last night (Nov. 14), with each winner receiving $50,000. “When things are going well, we have to give back. We need to see you guys get blessed,” the Toronto rapper said. Drake also congratulated the winners and teased even bigger plans for the holidays, saying, “Holiday giveaway is going to be insane. ” Powered by.
